clues.title: Coverage: Police follow car
text: In Nigeria, Street View coverage often includes a police escort car visible "behind" the Street View car. However, it may sometimes be missing, so don’t rule out Nigeria if you don’t see it.

clues.title: Islamic: North
text: Nigeria is mainly Christian in the south, and Islamic in the north.
As such, seeing women in hijabs and men in muslim attire is more common in the north.

clues.title: Landscape: Open Landscape
text: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more open and arid landscape compared to Niger state.
The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may not be trees at all.
These states are entirely covered by shitcam.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Rocky Landscape
text: A savannah landscape combined with rocky hills can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba.
The hills in the far east and west of this region are typically greener and covered in more vegetation compared to the hills toward the middle of the range.
**NOTE:**
Around the city of Gombe, hills composed of softer, clay-like soil can be seen instead.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Kano State
text: If you find yourself in an arid, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of corn around, you are likely to be in Kano state.
It is only covered by shitcam, without any Generation 3 or 4.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Kaduna State
text: These haystacks are extremely common and are almost exclusively found in Kaduna state.

clues.title: Vegetation: Niger State
text: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state.
It is almost entirely covered by shitcam, and can be recognized by the scattered trees, reddish soil, and dry grass.

clues.title: Landscape: Benue State
text: Benue state can be recognized by the lush, green grass covered ground, with reddish soil.
The vegetation is somewhat scattered, with the grass making way for taller trees.
Thatched huts are also common in comparison to other southern states.
**NOTE:**
An abundance of palms should make you lean toward the bordering southern states that can look similar.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Coverage: Shitcam
text: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this low-quality coverage, known as official ari, or “shitcam”.

clues.title: Pole: Poles
text: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete.
They have indents with a few horizontal supports, and are similar to the ones used in Brazil, but do not have holes through them.

clues.title: Google car: Gen 4 Truck
text: A visible Street View car is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible.
The colour of the cab and other features of it varies. In Generation 3, a roof rack is present.
You may also find a large blur covering the entire pickup truck.

clues.title: Architecture: Architecture

clues.title: Vegetation: A121
text: The A121 can be recognized by the lush, tropical vegetation surrounding the divided highway, with a short, concrete median. Being a major highway, many vehicles, especially trucks, can be seen along it.
NOTE: The A232 heading east of Benin City is also divided, however the median is noticeably wider than that of the A121.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Takum-Jalingo road
text: A dry, hazy, and somewhat gloomy landscape in Generation 3 combined with sizable mountains in the distance can be found on the road heading north of Takum to Jalingo. This smudge, which gets darker further north, is also seen at the front of the camera.
NOTE: The coverage is broken on many parts of the road, so knowing where coverage exists can be helpful.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: A3 Yobe State
